name: agent-bridge-ide-snapshot
description: Writes a lightweight IDE state snapshot for the agent-bridge ide_snapshot MCP tool.

agentBridge.snapshotPath.description: Optional absolute path for ide-snapshot.json. Defaults to <workspace>/.agent-bridge/ide-snapshot.json, then AGENT_BRIDGE_IDE_SNAPSHOT.

agentBridge.commandDir.description: Optional directory for ide-commands.jsonl and ide-responses.jsonl. Defaults to the directory containing ide-snapshot.json.

agentBridge.maxSelectionChars.description: Maximum selected text characters to include in the snapshot.

agentBridge.maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum diagnostics to include in the snapshot.

agentBridge.refreshIntervalMs.description: Periodic snapshot refresh interval in milliseconds (keeps mtime fresh during agent-panel focus). 0 disables the timer.
